control.name: CONTROL — invert the head-pin (a verdict lands on code the reviewer did NOT review)

mutations.name: disarm the model-capability floor refusal on the VERDICT path (a below-tier or self-applied-stamp session posts a verdict freely)
mutations.old:
case deskkit.FloorRefuse:
			return withDigest(refused(verb, repo, pr, curHead, fd.Message), dig)

mutations.name: disarm the model-capability floor refusal on the FLIP path (a below-tier session flips a PR ready via deskpost ready)
mutations.old:
case deskkit.FloorRefuse:
			return refused("ready", repo, pr, head, fd.Message)

mutations.name: widen the verify-gate card carve-out from the LABEL to the AUTHOR (every github-actions[bot] issue becomes commentable, not just a sign-off card)
drop the carve-out's author check (the verify-gate label alone admits a comment, so an external user self-labelling their own issue clears the trust gate)
